title: Text Mining Approaches Applied to Patents: A Scoping Review Protocol
author: Homa Arshadi
materials: type and method of review Scoping review

steps.title: Perform Literature Search
steps.instruction: Execute a search for English-language original articles and conference papers using the specified keywords and syntax in databases such as Web of Science (WoS).

substeps.instruction: Use search syntax #1: TS=(( ( text* AND ( analy* OR mining OR categorization OR classification OR cluster* OR extract* OR preprocessing OR processing OR transformation ) ) OR ( data AND mining ) OR "document classification" OR "document cluster*" OR "document summarization" OR "machine learning" OR "keyword extraction" OR "keyword discovery" OR "keyword retrieval" OR ( ( information OR knowledge ) AND ( extract* OR discovery OR retrieval ) ) OR "Latent Dirichlet Allocation" OR LDA OR "Latent Semantic Analysis" OR LSA OR "Natural Language Processing" OR NLP OR "content analysis" OR "topic extraction" OR "topic model*" OR "unstructured text" OR "unsupervised learning" OR "Vector Space Model" OR "VSM" OR "support vector machines" OR "naive bayes classifier" OR "association rules" OR "k-nearest neighbor" OR "neural networks" OR "decision trees" ) )) AND TS=(patent OR patents )

Use search syntax #2: TS=(( "patent analy*" OR "patent mining" OR "patent cluster*" OR "patent map*" OR "patent roadmap*" OR "patent network" OR "patent visualization" OR "patent visualisation" OR patentometric* OR "patent classification*" OR "patent retrieval" ))
Limit results to Articles and Conference papers

steps.title: Manage and Filter Results
steps.instruction: Export search results to EndNote 20 and remove duplicate publications.

substeps.instruction: Import the remaining unique papers into Rayyan for review.

steps.title: Screen Studies for Eligibility
steps.instruction: Screen papers against inclusion and exclusion criteria using a two-stage process.

substeps.instruction: Two independent research members screen titles and abstracts against eligibility criteria.
Two reviewers independently assess the full-text of potentially relevant papers.
Resolve conflicts through discussion or consultation with a third author to reach consensus.

steps.title: Extract Data
steps.instruction: Chart key findings from included studies using a data extraction tool developed in Excel.

substeps.instruction: Two review team members independently extract the following data: title, author, publication year, Journal, techniques, tools or applications of text mining, data sources, patent metadata (Claims, Abstract, Title or description), subject area, sample size, and the purpose of the study.
Solve discrepancies by consulting with a third expert.

steps.title: Synthesize and Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Categorize the extracted data to map the current state of patent text mining.

substeps.instruction: Categorize by types of different text mining techniques and patent data sources.
Compare the frequency of use of different patent metadata.
Identify the most used subject areas and sample sizes.
